theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_coarea_glue
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ ν : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) (J g : X → ℝ≥0∞) (M : Set X) (W : ℕ → Set X), Measurable f → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (W i)) → (∀ i, W i ⊆ M) → Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint W) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict (M \ ⋃ i, W i)), J x * g x = 0) → (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ν ((M \ ⋃ i, W i) ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0) → (∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in W i ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in W i ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in W i, J x * g x ∂μ) → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in M, J x * g x ∂μ
